review: I like the readable hazards and the mechanic-per-stage structure, but the curve is wrong. Saw Mill at stage 3 has a 37% pass rate, harder than Gauntlet, and its saws float at jump height with little telegraph. Ferry Lines gives 12.3 s to every skill level, so the platform cycle sets my time, not my execution. First Steps shows the mid ghost stuck in front of spikes for three seconds, and Spike Garden takes the high-skill ghost 25 s. Crumble Bridge, Spring Loaded and Laser Gate flow well. Gauntlet mixes everything fairly, but the laser kill on the best player looks like a cycle trap.
best: Crumble Bridge and Spring Loaded keep me moving and reward commitment with clean, readable routes.
worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3, and Ferry Lines has no time to save because the ferries gate everyone equally.
